categories.name: Contribute
categories.description_text: Contributing to an open-source project isn’t limited to coding. Share product ideas, report bugs and UX issues, or share ideas for how to improve our community. Learn more…

categories.name: Site feedback
categories.description_text: Discussion about meta.discourse.org itself - the organization of this forum, how it works, and how we can improve this site.

categories.name: Feature
categories.description_text: Share your ideas and suggestions about how to improve Discourse with new features or improvements to existing ones. Upvote ideas others have shared previously and share more context about your use cases and why they’d be valuable to you → Requesting new features for Discourse

categories.name: Bug
categories.description_text: A bug report means something is broken, preventing normal/typical use of Discourse. Do be sure to search prior to submitting bugs. Include repro steps, and only describe one bug per topic please. If your topic is about an official plugin, include the plugin tag.

categories.name: UX
categories.description_text: For general discussions about the user experience design of Discourse, how to improve it, and discussing issues where Discourse works as intended, but the design, interaction, or flow creates unnecessary friction, confusion, or inefficiency for users. Also for small “quality of life” improvements (which may be marked completed or fixed).
